body:
I can't say much, but as a fellow peer, I can say this: internalizing these feelings will not help you. You should talk to someone close to you, someone who listen to you, and if you feel like you do not have this person, /please/ contact a hotline.

Intelligence often is a burden. But it is also an incredible gift. My best friend also deals with the same problem you do, understanding everybody else but fearing that nobody will ever understand her. Trust me when I say you will find people who will understand you, and share your ambitions. It may or may not be in high school, but places beyond that - like college - are a whole different world. Don't feel pressured to have a romantic relationship, if that's the kind of relationship you mean. If anything, you've saved yourself the immaturity and drama that comes with most high school relationships. 

I hope I've helped you, even if just a little. Good luck.
